examples.text: ye'pi te, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyath'idaṃ, pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto, pakudho kaccāyano, ajito kesakambalo
abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.
seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu, te'pi evam'āhaṃsu, mayam'etaṃ jānāma, mayam'etaṃ passāma. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?

20802.meaning1: Kassapa's monastery; (comm) monastery built by Kassapa

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā assaji kassapak'ārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.

atha kho kassapagottassa bhikkhuno bhagavati sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya bhikkhū sandassente samādapente samuttejente sampahaṃsente ahu'd'eva akkhanti ahu appaccayo, adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.

20807.commentary: (SNa) yo vā pan'assa kassapasadiso'ti etthā'pi yo vā pan'añño'pi kassapasadiso mahākassapatthero viya catūsu paccayesu tīhi santosehi santuṭṭho bhaveyya, tumhe'pi tathārūpā bhavathā'ti ovadanto kassapasadisena ovadati nāma.

examples.text: evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ. kassapena vā hi vo, bhikkhave, ovadissāmi yo vā pan'assa kassapasadiso, ovaditehi ca pana vo tath'attāya paṭipajjitabban'ti.

20811.meaning1: we will do; we will make

examples.text: dhātu āveṇikā n'atthi, sarīraṃ ekapiṇḍitaṃ, imamhi buddhathūpamhi, kassāma kañcukaṃ mayaṃ.

20812.meaning1: I will do; I will make

examples.text: tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, na t'āhaṃ kassāmi yathā atandito, biḷārabhastaṃ'va yathā sumadditaṃ.

20814.meaning1: (gram) k-series; group of guttural consonants beginning with the letter k (k, kh, g, gh, ṅ)

examples.text: abbhāse vattamānassa kavaggassa cavaggo hoti. cikicchati, jigucchati, jighacchati, jigīsati, jaṅgamati, caṅkamati.
a kavagga hā kaṇṭhajā, i cavagga yā tālujā, u pavaggā oṭṭhajā, ṭavagga ra ḷā muddhajā, tavagga la sā dantajā, e kaṇṭhatālujo, o kaṇṭh'oṭṭhajo, vo dant'oṭṭhajo.

20815.meaning1: coat of a mail; suit of armour

examples.text: tulam'atulañ'ca sambhavaṃ, bhavasaṅkhāram'avassaji muni, ajjhattarato samāhito, abhindi kavacam'iv'attasambhavan'ti.

20816.commentary: (JAa) kabandhe'ti tassa kira gīvā onamitvā uraṃ allīnā, tasmā chinnasīso viya khāyati.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ asīsakaṃ kavandhaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ. tassa ure akkhīni c'eva honti mukhañ'ca.
diṭṭhā mayā, samma puṇṇamukha, kaṇhā dvepitikā pañcapatikāya chaṭṭhe purise cittaṃ paṭibandhantiyā, yadidaṃ kavandhe pīṭhasappimhī'ti.

20817.meaning1: lump; morsel; mouthful; lump of food

20818.commentary: (MNa) kabaḷīkāro āhāro'ti kabaḷaṃ katvā ajjhoharitabbato kabaḷīkāro āhāro, odana-kummās'ādi-vatthukāya ojāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: katame cattāro dhammā pariññeyyā? cattāro āhārā, kavaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ. ime cattāro dhammā pariññeyyā.

20819.commentary: (VINa) kavāṭapiṭṭhan'ti kavāṭañ'ca piṭṭhasaṅghātañca acchupantena. (NIDD1a) kavāṭaṃ vā'ti dvāravātapān'ādi-kavāṭaṃ vā.

examples.text: paṭicchannaṃ nāma āsanaṃ kuṭṭena vā kavāṭena vā kilañjena vā sāṇipākārena vā rukkhena vā thambhena vā kotthaḷiyā vā yena kenaci paṭicchannaṃ hoti.
atha kho so bhikkhu vihāraṃ pavisissāmī'ti kavāṭaṃ paṇāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ, vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante, disvāna bhīto vissaram'akāsi.

20821.meaning1: with a door; fitted with a door
20821.meaning2: closed or fastened with a door; fitted with a door

examples.text: bhikkhuniyā'ti aññāya bhikkhuniyā. upassayo nāma kavāṭabaddho vuccati. datvā'ti sayaṃ datvā.
ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lop'ānubandh'ariyam'attha-vibhāga-tīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.

20823.commentary: (SNa) kavito hi gāthā pavattanti. so tāsaṃ patiṭṭhā hotī'ti.

examples.text: ye pana te sutt'antā kavikatā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti
chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.

20824.meaning1: written by poets; composed by singers

examples.text: ye pana te sutt'antā kavikatā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti

20826.commentary: (ANa) kavitā'ti kavīhi katā. itaraṃ tass'eva vevacanaṃ. (SNt) kavito'ti vicittakathīādito.

examples.text: ye pana te sutt'antā kavitā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsanti sotaṃ odahanti aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti

20830.synonym: kattha, kuvaṃ, kuhiṃ, kva, kvanu, kvannu

te puttamaṃsāni c'eva khādeyyuṃ, ure ca paṭipiseyyuṃ, kahaṃ, ekaputtaka, kahaṃ, ekaputtakā'ti

20831.meaning1: silver coin; (comm) made of gold, silver, or common (metal)
20831.meaning2: coin whose value is about a half-crown
20831.commentary: (VINa) kahāpaṇo'ti sovaṇṇamayo vā rūpiyamayo vā pākatiko vā.

examples.text: na kahāpaṇavassena, titti kāmesu vijjati, app'assādā dukhā kāmā, iti viññāya paṇḍito
rajataṃ nāma kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.

20832.meaning2: torture which consisted in cutting off small pieces of flesh
20832.commentary: (ANa) kahāpaṇikan'ti sakalasarīraṃ tiṇhāhi vāsīhi koṭito paṭṭhāya kahāpaṇamattaṃ, kahāpaṇamattaṃ pātentā koṭṭenti.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, daṇḍabhayaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco passati coraṃ āgucāriṃ, rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente… kahāpaṇakam'pi karonte, khārāpatacchikam'pi karonte, palighaparivattikam'pi karonte, palālapīṭhakam'pi karonte, tattena'pi telena osiñcante, sunakhehi'pi khādāpente…

20833.meaning1: worth one silver coin; one silver coin in value

20834.commentary: (SNa) kahāpaṇasatan'ti pātarāse paṇṇāsaṃ sāyamāse paṇṇāsan'ti evaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ.

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ, tāta sudassana, bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā mama bhatt'ābhihāre bhāsa. ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti.
mahāsatto pana āgacchanto kahāpaṇasahassena saddhiṃ ekasāṭakayugaṃ tambūlapasibbake ṭhapetvā āgato.

20836.commentary: (MNa) kahāpaṇikan'ti sakalasarīraṃ tiṇhāhi vāsīhi koṭito paṭṭhāya kahāpaṇamattaṃ kahāpaṇamattaṃ pātentā koṭṭenti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… cīrakavāsikam'pi karonti, eṇeyyakam'pi karonti, baḷisamaṃsikam'pi karonti, kahāpaṇikam'pi karonti, khārāpatacchikam'pi karonti, palighaparivattikam'pi karonti
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsan'ti.

20838.meaning1: bag of cow peas; (comm) broken cow peas

examples.text: ettha yo icchati taṇḍulapaṭibhastāni vā muggapaṭibhastāni vā kaḷāyapaṭibhastāni vā nikkhipitvā yaṃ icchati taṃ haratū'ti. ghaṭikāro kho, mahārāja, kumbhakāro andhe jiṇṇe mātāpitaro poseti.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsan'ti.

20841.meaning1: (of teeth) protruding; projecting; jutting out; bucktoothed

20842.commentary: (SNa) kaḷārakhattiyo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. dantā pan'assa kaḷārā visamasaṇṭhānā, tasmā kaḷāro'ti vuccati.

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca, moḷiyaphagguno, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīn'āyāvatto'ti. na hi nūna so āyasmā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye assāsam'alatthā'ti.

20843.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

20844.meaning1: name of a king; son of king Nimi
20844.commentary: (MNa) kaḷārajanako'ti tassa nāmaṃ. kaḷāradantatāya pana kaḷārajanako'ti vutto.

examples.text: nimissa kho pan'ānananda, rañño kaḷārajanako nāma putto ahosi. na so agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji. so taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ samucchindi. so tesaṃ antimapuriso ahosi.
tena kho pana samayena acelo kaḷāramaṭṭako vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati lābh'aggappatto c'eva yas'aggappatto ca vajjigāme.

20847.meaning2: block or piece of wood; chopping block; executioner's block

examples.text: kaḷibho nāma, bhante, ñātike upāsako kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?

20851.meaning2: edible shoot or sprout (especially of a bamboo)
20851.commentary: (THa) kaḷīro'ti aṅkuro, idha pana vaṃsaṅkuro adhippeto. (NIDD2) vaṃsakkaḷīro'va asajjamāno'ti vaṃso vuccati veḷugumbo. yathā veḷugumbasmiṃ taruṇakā kaḷīrakā asattā alaggā agadhitā apalibuddhā nikkhantā nissaṭā vippamuttā evam'eva.

examples.text: yathā kaḷīro susu vaḍḍhit'aggo, dunnikkhamo hoti pasākhajāto, evaṃ ahaṃ bhariyāy'ānitāya, anumaññaṃ maṃ pabbajito'mhi dānī'ti.
vaṃso visālo'va yathā visatto, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā, vaṃsakkaḷīro'va asajjamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

20852.synonym: kāyadhātu, gahaka, deha, bhastā, sandeha, samussaya, sarīra

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

20854.synonym: kāyadhātu, gahaka, deha, bhastā, sandeha, samussaya, sarīra
20854.commentary: (SNa) kaḷevare'ti attabhāve (SDt) byāmamatte kaḷevare'ti byāmappamāṇe attabhāve. iminā rūpakkhandhaṃ dasseti. (VMVt) byāmamatte kaḷevare'ti sarīre. tena rūpakkhandhaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ? yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvit'indriyass'upacchedo, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ
kiṃ te idha sārasammataṃ, kuṇapapūramhi susānavaḍḍhane, bhedanadhamme kaḷevare, yaṃ disvā vimano udikkhasi.
phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā, rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato, parisussati khippam'idaṃ kaḷevaraṃ, pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.

nikkhanto kho te, bhante, upaṭṭhāko anto kaḷopiyā kummāsaṃ gahetvā pariyogā sūpaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjāti. atha khv'āhaṃ, mahārāja, kaḷopiyā kummāsaṃ gahetvā pariyogā sūpaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjitvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃ.

20858.commentary: (MNa) khaṭopikā'ti vilīvamañcako. (MNt) taṃsabhāve ṭhitassa bodhā na tu dukkarā, sā khaṭopikā. sā kumbhī.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiyo, tass'assa ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kāk'ātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā kaḷopikā oluggaviluggā naparamarūpā, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā jāyikā naparamarūpā.

20859.meaning1: mouth of a vessel; (comm) mouth of a pot or a basket
20859.commentary: (DNa) na kaḷopimukhā'ti kaḷopī'ti ukkhali vā pacchi vā, tato'pi na gaṇhati. kasmā? kumbhikaḷopiyo maṃ nissāya kaṭacchunā pahāraṃ labhantī'ti.

examples.text: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya
seyyathā'pi, bhante, caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantakavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati.

20861.meaning1: bowl; basin; (comm) pot or a basket
20861.commentary: (DNa) kaḷopī'ti ukkhali vā pacchi vā (ANa) kaḷopihattho'ti pacchihattho ukkhalihattho vā.

examples.text: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya
seyyathā'pi, bhante, caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantakavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati.

20863.grammar: pron, interr, masc fem & nt acc sg of ka

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa etadahosi, kaṃ nu kho bhagavā puggalaṃ sandhāya evam'āha, aparisuddhā, ānanda, parisā'ti?
ko'dha santusito loke, kassa no santi iñjitā, ko ubh'antam'abhiññāya, majjhe mantā na lippati, kaṃ brūsi mahāpuriso'ti, ko idha sibbinim'accagā.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpak'antevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītidhenusahassāni ahesuṃ dukūlasandanāni kaṃs'ūpadhāraṇāni.
hitvā satapalaṃ kaṃsaṃ, sovaṇṇaṃ satarājikaṃ, aggahiṃ mattikāpattaṃ, idaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno, so ca kho visena saṃsaṭṭho.
sace n'eresi attānaṃ, kaṃso upahato yathā, esa patto'si nibbānaṃ, sārambho te na vijjati.

dūteyyapahiṇagamana-anuyogā paṭivirato hoti, kayavikkayā paṭivirato hoti, tulākūṭakaṃsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭivirato hoti

20870.commentary: (DNa) kaṃsathāle'ti yena kenaci lohena katabhājane. mattikabhājanaṃ pana thiraṃ na hoti. sannentassa bhijjati. tasmā taṃ na dasseti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpak'antevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya

20871.commentary: (VINa) kaṃsanīlan'ti cammakāranīlaṃ. mahāpaccariyaṃ pana, ayomalaṃ lohamalaṃ etaṃ kaṃsanīlaṃ nāmā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: nīlaṃ nāma dve nīlāni, kaṃsanīlaṃ, palāsanīlaṃ.
atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi, bhuñjatu bhavaṃ gotamo pāyasaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā rajena ca malena ca pariyonaddhā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā na c'eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca pariyodapeyyuṃ, raj'āpathe ca naṃ nikkhipeyyuṃ.
atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ pukkusātiṃ etadavoca, kaṃ'si tvaṃ, bhikkhu, uddissa pabbajito? ko vā te satthā? kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesī'ti?
kaṃ'si tvaṃ, āvuso, uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesī'ti?

20876.meaning1: with bronze milk pails; (comm) with silver milking vessels

satimatī cakkhumatī, bhikkhunī bhāvit'indriyā, paṭivijjhiṃ padaṃ santaṃ, akāpurisasevitaṃ.
ku'icc'etassa kā hoti app'atthesu ca.

puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ kaṅkehi vā khajjamānaṃ

taṃ idh'eva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti siṅgālā vā khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti, yañ'ca khv'assa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ… taṃ uddhagāmi hoti visesagāmi.

20886.commentary: (MNa) kākapeyyo'ti mukhavaṭṭiyaṃ nisīditvā kākena gīvaṃ anāmetvā'va pātabbo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo. tam'enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakamaṇiko pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo ādhāre ṭhapito. atha puriso āgaccheyya udakabhāraṃ ādāya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso labhetha udakassa nikkhepanan'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
